info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Careers Applications Offer-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Offer API enables organizations to efficiently submit multiple job applications in a single batch operation. This service is tailored for employers and recruitment platforms looking to streamline the hiring process by quickly processing and managing candidate offers. By utilizing this API, users can improve productivity, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance the overall applicant experience. Ideal for HR departments and recruitment agencies, the API supports seamless integration with existing hiring systems to optimize application workflows.

post.summary: Create a new offer for an application.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new offer associated with a specific application. Ensure that all required fields are provided to successfully generate an offer.
